digest.component_or_area: DC comment/description text fit and convergence
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for comment and description truncation that are present in Cloud, creating risk of regressing truncation behavior undetected

DC's sanitize_comment binds comment truncation to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT and the description fitter fit_outbound, but the provenance and correctness of the 32767 character ceiling for comments is undocumented and conflated with description limits

Tests injecting only outbound_mapper without all three of outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, and links will silently fall back to Cloud's backend via config, causing DC convergence tests to validate against Cloud's truncation logic instead of DC's

_diff_comments can be called without an explicit sanitizer parameter, causing it to resolve the backend from config and potentially use Cloud's sanitizer even when testing DC behavior, making the convergence test vacuous

The 32767 character limit for DC comments is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit which covers both Description and Comments, not an assumption; this provenance must be cited in source to replace the undocumented binding
